newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-US woes shroud bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-US woes shroud bloc.

text.p: The Australian bond market recovered some lost ground against the dollar bloc after Tuesday's underperformance, although markets remain wary ahead of the U.S. February CPI later today.

The largest move was against Canadian debt, which suffered at the hand of a weakening Canadian dollar after Bank of Canada governor Gordon Thiessen indicated that the central bank would not necessarily follow a tightening by the Federal Reserve.
The U.S. Treasury market continues to shroud the dollar bloc with a negative tone amid expectaions that the Fed will tighten policy when the Federal Open Market Committee meets on March 25.
New Zealand debt was slightly undermined by comments by the RBNZ govenor Don Brash that the kiwi dollar was somewhat overvalued.
